name: messaging
title: Messaging
description: One-to-one conversations with unread counts, read state, new messages by polling, report and block. Licence: MIT.

files.content:
-- Apply before serving the block. Idempotent on an existing app database.
-- One row per report, block, hidden item and decision.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS crm_report (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  scope text NOT NULL,
  kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('item', 'person')),
  ref text NOT NULL CHECK (length(ref) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
  reason text NOT NULL CHECK (length(reason) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000),
  reported_by text NOT NULL,
  reported_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  automatic boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (status IN ('open', 'hidden', 'dismissed')),
  decided_by text,
  decided_at timestamptz,
  CHECK ((status = 'open') = (decided_by IS NULL AND decided_at IS NULL)),
  CHECK (status <> 'hidden' OR kind = 'item')
);
-- One open report per reporter and target; reviewed reports do not block a new one.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS crm_report_open_once ON crm_report (scope, reported_by, kind, ref) WHERE status = 'open';
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS crm_report_queue ON crm_report (scope, reported_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS crm_block (
  scope text NOT NULL,
  viewer text NOT NULL,
  other text NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (scope, viewer, other),
  CHECK (viewer <> other)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS crm_hidden_item (
  scope text NOT NULL,
  ref text NOT NULL,
  hidden_by text NOT NULL,
  hidden_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (scope, ref)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS crm_moderation_audit (
  id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  scope text NOT NULL,
  report_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES crm_report (id),
  action text NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('hide', 'dismiss')),
  actor text NOT NULL,
  at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  kind text NOT NULL,
  ref text NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS crm_moderation_audit_recent ON crm_moderation_audit (scope, at DESC);

-- Apply before serving the block. Idempotent on an existing app database. One row per profile.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS crm_profile (
  scope text NOT NULL,
  person text NOT NULL CHECK (length(person) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
  revision integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0),
  name text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(name) <= 100),
  bio text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(bio) <= 500),
  links jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]' CHECK (jsonb_typeof(links) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(links) <= 5),
  photo jsonb CHECK (photo IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(photo) = 'object'),
  pending_photo text,
  public_name boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  public_bio boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  public_links boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  public_photo boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (scope, person)
);

-- Apply after the profiles and moderation migrations. Idempotent on an existing app database.
-- One row per one-to-one conversation and per message. person_a sorts before person_b in the app.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS crm_conversation (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  scope text NOT NULL,
  person_a text NOT NULL CHECK (length(person_a) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
  person_b text NOT NULL CHECK (length(person_b) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
  started_by text NOT NULL,
  read_a bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  read_b bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (scope, person_a, person_b),
  CHECK (person_a <> person_b),
  CHECK (started_by IN (person_a, person_b))
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS crm_conversation_a ON crm_conversation (scope, person_a, last_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS crm_conversation_b ON crm_conversation (scope, person_b, last_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS crm_message (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  seq bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY UNIQUE,
  scope text NOT NULL,
  conversation_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES crm_conversation (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  sender text NOT NULL,
  body text NOT NULL CHECK (length(body) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS crm_message_by_conversation ON crm_message (conversation_id, seq DESC);
